propositions: Dense criterion verification runs exhaust bounded request budgets with zero incrementally banked verdicts, violating the recovery contract and replacing evidence-backed PASS/FAIL with CompletionRecoveryError

Pydantic AI executes model response tool batches concurrently, making prompt-only serialization insufficient to enforce one evidence action per response and deferred every record call until budget exhaustion

The completion contract relied on subjective low-authority prompt instructions rather than explicit finite state transitions, allowing models to defer banking until after resource limits on dense multi-criterion runs
A completion-only wrapper policy with atomic per-response action claiming and automatic fail-closed banking at the third evidence response ensures progress is banked before exhaustion
The policy attaches only to privately flagged completion tools via metadata attribute, preserving byte-identical behavior for unflagged requests and all public schemas, signatures, and exit codes
